definitions.full: H7069. qanah I. קָנָה 84 verb get, acquire (Late Hebrew = Biblical Hebrew; Phoenician (Punic) מקנא , property [in cattle]; Assyrian ‡anû , gain , acquire , Meissn Suppl. 85 ; Arabic (,) acquire, procure ; Sabean קני acquire, possess , CIS iv,no.89, 5.6 , קני noun property Id ib,no.3, 8, 29, 3 ; Ethiopic acquire, subjugate ; Aramaic קְנָא , ( accquire ); — Qal 81 Perfect 3masculine singular ׳ק Gen 25:10 +; suffix נ֑ךָ קֶָ Deut 32:6 , קָנָהוּ Lev 27:24 ; 3 feminine singular קָֽנְתָה Psa 78:54 ; 2 masculine singular קָנִיתָ Exod 15:16 +, etc.; Imperfect 3masculine singular יִקְנֶךְ Lev 22:11 +, וַיִ֫קֶן Gen 33:19 +, etc.; Imperative masculine singular קְנֵח 47:19 +; Infinitive absolute קָנֹה Lev 25:14 ; 1Chr 21:24 , קָנוֺ 2Sam 24:24 ; cstr . קְנֹה Prov 16:16 , קְנוֺת 16:16 +, etc.; Participle קֹנֶה Deut 28:68 , קְוֺנֶה Prov 15:32 +, etc.; — 1 get, acquire (all poetry) : a. of God as originating, creating , וָאָרֶץ שָׁמַיִם קֹנֵה Gen 14:19 , 22 ; Deut 32:6 (Israel), Psa 139:13 ( כִּלְֹיתָ֑י ); Prov 8:22 ( חכמה q. v.). b. of God as victoriously redeeming his people Exod 15:16 ; Isa 11:11 ; Psa 74:2 (|| גָּאַל ) object הַרוֶֿה 78:54 . c. of Eve, acquiring ׳אֶתיֿ קַיִן, (i.e. with the help of ), Gen 4:1 (J). d. of acquiring wisdom, knowledge (only Proverbs): Prov 1:5 ; 4:5 (twice in verse); 4:7 (twice in verse); 15:32 ; 16:16 (twice in verse); 17:16 ; 18:15 ; 19:8 ; 23:23 . 2 elsewhere buy Exod 21:2 (E), Gen 47:22 (J), 50:13 (P), Lev 27:24 (H), Deut 28:68 ; Isa 24:2 ; Jer 13:1 ; Ezek 7:12 ; Prov 20:14 +; קֹנֶה owner , as purchaser Lev 25:30 (P) Isa 1:3 ; Zech 11:5 +. Niph`al be bought : Perfect 3masculine singular נִקְנָה Jer 32:43 ; Imperfect 3masculine plural יִקָּנוּ 32:15 . Hiph`il Perfect 3masculine singular suffix חִקְנַנִי אָדָם Zech 13:5 ; AV makes denominative of מִקְנֶה cattle ; Thes RV Marti Kau Buhl caused (one) to purchase me , i.e. made me a bondman ; < We Now GASm read קִנְיָנִי אֲרָמָה — Participle מַקְנֶה see קנא .
